value_str: Logit coefficients (log-odds), model-based standard errors in parentheses. Reference arm: control. Columns (1), (3)--(6) use survey weights; column (2) does not. Columns (3)--(6) control for FX status, age, female, education, and urban/rural; column (4) adds income quintile and left-right, which restricts the sample to respondents with both. Column (6) keeps urban respondents only.
